designer-initial.summary: Selected a finite station cargo-transfer evidence coordinator with an exact 15/33/28/11 hard-tier target, five retained-state owners, explicit priority, fault propagation, two-event recovery, and atomic result composition.
questions_for_model: Can the supported SysML-AADL and GUMBO subset expose prior-state views from five independent state owners and constrain post-transition values without a combinational cycle between evidence coherence and recovery?
Can the independent bounded analyzer exhaust 4,838,400 one-step combinations with per-case witnesses under practical tool limits, or is a semantics-preserving analysis factorization required?
Can exactly 33 semantic interactions be lowered through exactly six uncredited root delegations and 39 raw connections using compatible flat enum or record ports with complete trace coverage?

Can owner-local contracts express simultaneous request, report, and control precedence so same-evaluation faults inhibit every ordinary state update while reset and verification stay on distinct evaluations?

model-review.summary: Add two admission-to-evidence-state interactions; the resulting 15/35/28/11 allocation is realizable without changing domain behavior.

findings.evidence: CASE-25 requires accepted cancellation to clear both ShipEvidenceState and WarehouseEvidenceState. PART-08 and PART-09 currently receive only coherence update/freeze values. Evidence coherence receives no request or admission input, and request admission sends its decision only to PART-07 and PART-11. Thus a healthy active PENDING snapshot with a matching cancel gives PART-09 the same assigned inputs as the corresponding no-request snapshot even though the required next evidence states differ.
findings.requested_change: Add an AdmissionDecision input to PART-08 and PART-09 plus INT-34 request_admission.admission_decision -> ship_evidence_lifecycle.admission_decision and INT-35 request_admission.admission_decision -> warehouse_evidence_lifecycle.admission_decision. Revise exact targets from 33 to 35 semantic interactions and from 39 to 41 raw connections, including frontmatter edge_count, ARCH-01, INT-AUD-01, BOUND-02, PASS-01, DS-ALT-01, and DS-COUNT-01. Preserve all PARTs, 28 cases, 11 scenarios, priority, recovery, and domain behavior.

findings.evidence: The extensional audit found a nonidentity local distinction for every claimed owner: PART-01 through PART-04 derive independently consumed many-to-one validity/kind/class/readiness facts; PART-05 through PART-10 make multi-input or prior-state-dependent choices; PART-11 through PART-13 classify proposal eligibility; PART-14 combines proposals by strict priority; and PART-15 combines decision and disposition while classifying mode/outcome. Exact-report, token, duplicate-publication, and unchanged-state copies receive no ownership credit.

Trusted Regulate.sysml and accepted terminal run 20260813T013430Z-factory-dispatch-hard-r1-a1 demonstrate GUMBO state, initialize, compute cases, In(state), and a typechecked delayed feedback in which order_lifecycle publishes prior_order_state == In(retained_order), outcome_qualification derives qualified_outcome, and lifecycle consumes that result. Library revision 9016cbcceefa92f0068e1811923704dd261d15f1 and Sireum v4.20260630.386eac9f support the required flat Data attributes, directed ports, connections, and containment.
findings.requested_change: Publish every prior-state view from In(owner_state), constrain post-state from received directives, use attribute members for GUMBO-inspected records, and never substitute current/post-state outputs into prior-view interactions.

findings.evidence: The declared product is exactly 9,600 input snapshots times 504 prior-state tuples, or 4,838,400 evaluations. Node v18.19.1 executed a same-cardinality arithmetic loop locally in 0.18 seconds, so there is no concrete resource basis to reduce the finite domains under the harness's 180-second watchdog. The harness checks exit, timeout, source hash, passed status, ownership evidence, zero diagnostic counters, and true checks, though oracle independence remains an auditable analyzer-design obligation.

With the two required sibling flows, 35 semantic raw connections plus the unchanged six transparent root-to-container delegations yield 41 raw connections. This remains within the hard interaction bound and requires no extra library support connection, no new usage, and no containment change.
findings.requested_change: Trace new INT-34 and INT-35 as semantic interactions, update every exact inventory and count assertion, and keep the six delegations uncredited.

designer-resolution.summary: Approved the narrow two-flow admission repair; final baseline is 15/35/28/11 with 41 raw connections.

model-generation.summary: Restored the interrupted Model decision handoff without changing source semantics; fresh SysML typechecking and bounded analysis passed, including source/metrics/trace hash consistency, hard 15/35/28/11 campaign-v1 counts, and passed=true on every ownership record.

visualization.summary: Accepted one validated source-bound system overview with 24 visible routes, zero crossings and route-object collisions, passed native review, and complete 170-association traceability review.
